provenance.source: NECB 2020 and NECB 2025 Division B Table 4.2.1.6, columns "Automatic Daylight Responsive Controls for Sidelighting [see 4.2.2.1.(10)]" and "... for Toplighting [see 4.2.2.1.(13)]", retrieved via the building-codes MCP (get_table necb 4.2.1.6, editions 2020 and 2025).
provenance.method: BOTH MCP extractions of Table 4.2.1.6 are partly corrupted, and they are corrupted DIFFERENTLY, so neither was vendored blind. The 2020 extraction is the worse of the two: its Space Category column lags the row it belongs to (a row reads 'Classroom/lecture hall/training room | Computer/Server room'), and it drops whole rows' worth of control marks - it carries 'Manual' = X on only 57 of 103 rows where 4.2.2.1.(3) makes that column apply to EVERY listed space type. The 2025 extraction keeps Space Category correct per row and carries Manual = X on 85 of 105 rows, so it is the primary source. The 2020 extraction is used ONLY to corroborate, never to negate: an X in the 2020 extraction where 2025 is blank is treated as a CONFLICT (state 'unknown'), not as an absence. Consequently an empty cell is NOT read as 'not required' on the strength of one extraction alone. Each of the 105 NECB space-function catalog names (openstudio-loads space_types_2020.json, -sch-A..K suffixes stripped) was mapped BY HAND to a table row, and every one of the 102 hard mappings was then validated by comparing the catalog's lighting_per_area (W/ft2 x 10.7639) against the table row's LPD (W/m2): 102 of 102 agree within 0.06 W/m2 / 1%. The three names with no table row and the six/seven columns left 'unknown' are enumerated in 'residue' below.

semantics.required: Table 4.2.1.6 carries 'X' in the column - 4.2.2.1.(10) or (13) applies to this space type, subject to its own power thresholds and to the (12)/(15) exceptions
semantics.not_required: the column is blank or a dash in BOTH extractions - the sentence does not apply to this space type
semantics.not_applicable: Table 4.2.1.6 refers this space type to a DIFFERENT article instead of carrying a flag (4.2.2.2. for interior storage garages, 4.2.2.6.(2) for guest rooms)
semantics.unknown: the two extractions CONFLICT, the cell holds header/footnote text, or the space type has no row at all. Callers must not silently decide - the gem WARNS and applies the documented conservative default
semantics.not_listed: the space type has NO Table 4.2.1.6 row at all, and 4.2.2.1.(10)/(13) apply only to spaces requiring the control 'in accordance with Table 4.2.1.6.' - so the sentences do not reach it. A determination from the code text, distinct from 'unknown'

- undefined -.note: catalog sentinel for an unlisted space function (4.2.1.6.(1)(b) is a human judgement); the gem's reference transform already hard-raises on it
